docs.title: Hospital Identity & Access Integration Project
docs.text: Welcome to a beginner-friendly, hands-on project for learning how enterprise systems integrate inside a simulated hospital environment.

docs.title: Your Mission
docs.text:
You are helping a fictional hospital build its identity infrastructure and integrate a new software application into the environment.

Throughout the project, you will work with:

  • VMware and virtual machines
  • Windows Server 2022
  • Active Directory
  • DNS and networking
  • Identity and Access Management
  • SMB and file permissions
  • Ubuntu Linux
  • LDAP
  • PowerShell
  • Software integration
  • Troubleshooting
